Aisha (Acme Inc.): Hey team — our integration started returning 403 on generation calls this morning, but embeddings still work. Happening for all users in our org. Request ID: rq_0b9f3c. Example curl below.
Aisha (Acme Inc.): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk.org-xxxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
Aisha (Acme Inc.): Response: 403 {\"error\":\"insufficient_scopes\", \"message\":\"missing scopes: inference.generate\"}
Maya (Customer Success): thanks Aisha — sorry about the break. quick question: was this API key provisioned via SSO (SCIM) or created directly in the console?
Aisha (Acme Inc.): It was provisioned via our SSO connector last year. We rotate keys monthly via SCIM. Note: the last rotation job ran at 2024-10-11T03:12Z.
Maya (Customer Success): copying @Devon from eng-oncall to help debug. can you confirm whether the token shows only embeddings perms in the entitlement service?
Devon (eng-oncall): pulling logs now. can you paste the full response headers if you have them? any x-request-id or x-auth-scope headers?
Aisha (Acme Inc.): x-request-id: rq_0b9f3c, x-auth-scopes: embeddings
Aisha (Acme Inc.): We don't see inference or rerank in that header.
Devon (eng-oncall): ok that matches the 403 body. in our auth service the token appears with scope set [\"embeddings\"] only — looks like the rotation job replaced the previous org-level key that had inference+embeddings.
Maya (Customer Success): did the SCIM rotation job recently change its provisioning template? we had a config tweak in October to limit default scopes for some groups.
provisioning-bot: automated note — SCIM provisioner run completed 2024-10-11T03:12Z for org acme-inc; applied role mapping profile: default-limited.
Nico (Security Ops): that role mapping was rolled out to reduce blast radius for service accounts. it intentionally omits inference and rerank.
Aisha (Acme Inc.): hmm we never requested that limitation. our product needs generation.
Devon (eng-oncall): quick repro steps for us: 1) create API key via SCIM using default-limited role mapping 2) call /v1/embeddings -> 200 3) call /v1/generate -> 403 with missing inference scope.
Devon (eng-oncall): repro cURL: 
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} - %{url_effective}\n" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.scimtest" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha-1\",\"input\":\"test\"}'
```
Devon (eng-oncall): server returns 403 + body: {\"error\":\"insufficient_scopes\",\"missing\":[\"inference.generate\"]}
Maya (Customer Success): next steps I'm taking: - flagged this to provisioning/product to revert the default mapping for orgs that have opted-in to generation - escalated to eng-identity (ENG-4589) - creating temporary customer workaround: create a console-managed org-api-key with inference+embeddings and send to Aisha with rotation notes.
Aisha (Acme Inc.): Appreciate the workaround. Does this mean our monthly SCIM rotation will keep stripping scopes until mapping is changed?
Nico (Security Ops): yes until we update mapping. We can create an allowlist so acme-inc retains inference and rerank. will do after ENG-4589 has a plan.
Devon (eng-oncall): low-risk patch: we can make SCIM provisioner preserve explicit scopes if the existing key had them on rotate. will propose in the ticket.
Aisha (Acme Inc.): ok thanks. can you confirm any audit logs we can check to show which rotation removed the scopes? Need that for our compliance team.
Maya (Customer Success): we'll attach the rotation event logs to the ticket. the entry shows 'applied role mapping profile default-limited'. will include actor (scim-service) and timestamp.
Aisha (Acme Inc.): Perfect — one more ask: can you tell us whether this affects dedicated/private installs or only hosted keys?
Devon (eng-oncall): Scoped to hosted SCIM flows only. Dedicated/private somes use on-prem identity integrations so not affected.
Maya (Customer Success): temporary token sent via secure link. please rotate after you confirm. :lock:
Aisha (Acme Inc.): Confirmed, temp key works for generate. thanks. :thumbsup:
Nico (Security Ops): Adding final note — policy tweak was intentional for new orgs. we missed flagging existing orgs that requested generation. follow-up item: better rollout checklist and customer notification (SEC-112).
Maya (Customer Success): closing loop here once ENG-4589 updates mapping and we verify rotation preserves scopes. leaving ticket open until patch deployed. :eyes:
